zh-CN.name: MiMo 模型余量检测
zh-CN.shortDesc: 定时巡检小米 MiMo 开放平台 Token Plan 的套餐额度：总量、已用、剩余与重置时间，余量偏低、消耗异常或登录失效时主动提醒，同一情况只提醒一次。只读，不花钱不改设置；需在 DesireCore 账号库保存 MiMo 账号，首次登录由你完成一次短信验证。

en-US.name: MiMo Quota Monitor
en-US.shortDesc: Checks the Token Plan quota on the Xiaomi MiMo open platform on a schedule — total, used, remaining and reset time — and notifies you once when quota runs low, consumption spikes or the login expires. Read-only, never spends money or changes settings; requires a MiMo account saved in the DesireCore account store and a one-time SMS verification that you complete yourself.
